# Read: unit U1b1b of goal the-deputy-acts-under-a-recorded-delegation

Subject: the round-1 diff against base 9257d0aefd7ef8d14545d03aaf4881d8f36e7570
(`read.diff` is byte-identical to `round-1/worktree.diff`), judged against the
U1b1b section (B4, B5, T2) of the build brief and its 2026-11-12 amendments.

## Result

AGREE. No material findings.

## Checklist item 1: the diff against the brief

- B4 `SelectDelegatedBatch` (`internal/landing/plain/batch.go:128-133`) refuses a
  provenance without Grant, Decision or Session, or with a class other than
  lane-recovery. `PersonSelection` and the delegated selection share one unexported
  body, `selectRecordedBatch` (`batch.go:135-260`); nothing is copied.
- Locks: the queue lock (`withLock(install)`), then the lane lock
  (`lock.File(lane.LockPath(home))`), the same order as `resume.go:49-54`. Under
  both locks it re-reads the lane registration and the unset fence, runs
  `DelegatedRecoveryHeld`, records `d.Hold` from `lane.ReadAgentState` (BarrenAt,
  BarrenFingerprint, last of BarrenLaunches) over any value the caller supplied,
  and compares the waiting set exactly: each named goal must be waiting
  (`batch.go:186-194`) and no waiting entry may be missing from the list (`:196-200`).
- The delegated selection gets no `StandingPause` (`personPause` is false).
  `BarrenStopAt` is bound from the latest open lane-return stop
  (`barrenStopAtLocked`), and that stop is closed with the actor "decision D".
  `Person` stays nil.
- B5: `lane.BarrenHeld` (`internal/landing/lane/view.go:126-138`) means Barren is at
  least barrenLimit and the fingerprint equals BarrenFingerprint. A nil
  fingerprint or a read error refuses. `DelegatedRecoveryHeld`
  (`internal/landing/plain/delegated.go`) refuses each case by name: not held, a
  pause (an unreadable pause counts as one), any open stop other than one
  RecordBarrenStop-shaped lane-return stop, an open incident, a recorded check whose
  process is gone, and a MERGE_HEAD. The MERGE_HEAD test treats exit 128 as "no
  merge", the same rule as `fix.go:327-331`. Production `Git` wraps the
  `*exec.ExitError` with `%w`, so `errors.As` finds it (`prove.go:1195-1210`).
- Person-path regression: unchanged in effect. Both callers of `PersonSelection`
  (`SelectPersonBatch`, `Resume`) pass an empty BarrenStopAt.
  `bindBarrenStopLocked` keeps its last caller (`batch_verbs.go:121`).
- Re-entry: nothing reached under the new lane lock takes the lane lock again.
  That covers batchIdle, ReadRunning, ReadRunningRegeneration, the production
  AgentRunning (launch list and AgentStarting), KeeperFingerprint, writeBatch and
  closeMatchingStopsLocked. `runRegeneration` and `sayWhenTheLaneLockIsHeld` take
  the lane lock but are not on this path.
- Scope: only the owner files changed (`batch.go`, `delegated.go` new, `view.go`)
  plus the named test file. Comments carry no ruling or decision ids. The tests run
  in parallel and make no toolchain calls.

## Checklist item 2: the tests

- The proof command `/usr/bin/true` runs nothing. The round's frozen unit check
  (`round-1/check-4189174458/output.log`) ran unit/internal/landing/plain,
  unit/internal/landing/lane, unit/cmd/metasystem, the static and contract groups and
  the `TestAudit` audits; all green, LANDING-CHECKED 0.
- Reader runs on this worktree: T2 `TestADelegatedSelectionCarriesNoPersonOverride`
  (18 rows), T2a, `TestResumeSelectionClearsHoldsOldestFirst`,
  `TestResumeSealedBatchRestartsWithNewcomer` and
  `TestRestartPreservesPersonSelectedMembers` all pass.
- Mutation (reader, through a `go test -overlay` copy; the worktree was not
  touched): with the waiting-set comparison skipped, row "waiting changed" records
  a batch and T2 fails, as the brief predicts.
- T2 covers every brief row: (a) held; (b) pause; (c) a stop of another loop, plus
  a reasoned pause; (d) incident; (e) a recorded check whose process is gone; (f)
  HandIn after the caller read the waiting goals; (h) a changed fingerprint. It
  adds rows for an unreadable pause, an unknown lane stop, an unreadable
  fingerprint, a merge in progress, a hold that is not held, a hold with no
  identity, and each missing provenance field.
- The bed's fingerprint asserts that both locks are held when the held state is
  read. Each refusal compares a whole-tree snapshot of the install and the home,
  so "no batch written" is proved. The held row checks that the batch survives
  `RecordedDelegatedBatch`, that the barren stop is closed, and that the
  caller-supplied Hold is overwritten.

## Non-gating observations

1. Low, not material. RELATION: new. The waiting-set comparison
   (`batch.go:196-200`) uses the raw queue state (`Entries`, StateWaiting), as the
   brief words it. The engine's own barren stop names
   `landing run --goals <pending>` (`stop.go:340-351`), and `pending` also drops
   waiting entries whose commit is already on origin/main (`queue.go:548-572`).
   When such an entry exists, a delegate that copies the stop's `--goals` is
   refused with "the waiting goals changed; repeat the selection with every waiting
   goal", and must include that goal. It can be recovered and it fails closed. U1b1c
   should source the delegate's goals from the same raw waiting set.
2. Low, not material. RELATION: new. `lane.BarrenHeld` (`view.go:126-138`) restates
   the held rule the status view already applies (`view.go:176-184`: Barren at least
   barrenLimit and the fingerprint equal to BarrenFingerprint) instead of the view
   calling it. The two copies agree today, but they could drift apart.
3. Low, not material. RELATION: new. Size: 165 changed production lines (`view.go`
   13, `batch.go` 93, `delegated.go` 59) against the row's 96 doubled. The test is
   149 lines against 160. This is under the 250-line production limit.
4. Low, not material. RELATION: new. An open batch with the same members is reused
   on the delegated path, as on the person path (`batch.go:206-224`). A delegated
   selection over a person-selected batch with identical members therefore replaces
   that batch's `Person` provenance with `Delegated`. This follows the brief's "the
   selection of PersonSelection with Delegated set and Person nil". It gives the
   delegate no extra reach: the delegated path refuses whenever any pause record
   exists, and a delegated batch runs with PersonAct false.

## Budget

Every checklist item was checked within the tool-call budget (about 30 of 48).

VERDICT: land
